public_payload.normalized_proposition: When the market realizes Google, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta have no growth source beyond generative AI, valuations of every public software company and many hardware companies will be hit hard.
conditions: when the market realizes big tech has no other growth avenues

statement.excerpt: Google, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta do not have any other ways to continue showing growth, and when the market works that out, there will be hell to pay, hell that will reverberate through the valuations of, at the very least, every public software company, and many of the hardware ones too.

from_speaker: do not have any other ways to continue showing growth
when the market works that out
there will be hell to pay
many of the hardware ones too
our_interpretation: Assess the supplied conditional forecast. The assertion about growth alternatives defines its antecedent; it is not separately scored as a historical observation.
In context, 'other ways' means growth avenues beyond generative AI.
The ordinary reading of 'hell to pay' through valuations is substantial losses in market equity values attributable to the stated market reassessment.
The antecedent requires documented market recognition that all four named companies lack other growth avenues. Concern about AI investment returns or AI competition alone does not establish it.
Retain the universal software scope. A declining sector index alone cannot establish losses at every public software company.
No numerical loss threshold, hardware-company count, geographic boundary, or response deadline is supplied. None is invented.
The specific rule for an unestablished conditional antecedent takes precedence over the general unresolved outcome for undated forecasts.
criteria.support_condition: A documented market reassessment establishes the stated antecedent, followed by substantial valuation losses attributable to that reassessment across every public software company and many public hardware companies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, a clearly completed market repricing provides firm-level counterexamples to the universal software prediction or shows that substantial, widespread valuation damage did not occur. Mere passage of time cannot contradict this undated forecast.

evidence.explanation: MSCI interprets the five-week correction as concentrated selling of crowded investments rather than a broad loss of confidence in AI growth. This weighs against treating that correction as the forecast's decisive event, without disproving a future conditional outcome.

evidence.excerpt: But there is a “reassessment under way” of AI’s anticipated returns.
evidence.explanation: This near-cutoff report describes reassessment of AI returns. It does not document recognition that Google, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta have no other growth avenues, so it cannot establish the antecedent.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated evidence that the market recognized the stated lack of alternative growth avenues at all four firms, followed by company-level evidence of the attributable valuation response. A decisive assessment would also need to address the universal software scope and the unspecified severity and response period.
